ccnrcom.channel.not_set: You haven't set a channel. Use /channel <channel>, e.g. /channel 462.5
ccnrcom.channel.cleared: You left the channel. /r is disabled until you set a new channel.
ccnrcom.channel.invalid: Invalid channel format. Use digits with a dot, e.g. 123.4 or 462.5625
ccnrcom.command.player_only: This command can only be used by a player in game
ccnrcom.voice.no_channel: No channel set — voice is proximity only
